test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Moti has thrown the balls.

options.text: The balls were thrown by Moti.
The balls have been thrown by Moti.
The balls were being thrown by Moti.
The balls had been thrown by Moti.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The balls have been thrown by Moti.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In an **active voice** sentence, **the subject performs the action on the object**.
 
• **Active Structure**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 
 
• **Example**: *The chef has cooked a delicious meal.*
